claim: LBNL estimates direct U.S. data-centre water use at roughly 66 billion liters and indirect water use around 800 billion liters, a ratio of about 12 to 1.
comparisonContext: This is the strongest numerical reason not to reduce the water issue to cooling alone.
scopeNote: U.S. data-centre water accounting context from the LBNL report; not a global estimate.
sourceTitle: 2024 United States Data Center Energy Usage Report
